title: CURRENCY ( -0.03125 ) is -0.0313: a half rounds away from zero

source.quote: Rounding up occurs if the 5th significant decimal is equal or larger than 5
source.supports: the rule, stated without saying what up means for a negative number

source.quote: A value that ends in .5 is rounded away from zero
source.supports: the rule CONVERT follows for integers, taken to hold for currency too

derivation: -0.03125 is -1/32, exact in a double, so the fifth decimal is exactly 5. Rounding the magnitude up gives -0.0313.
alternative: "Rounding up" means towards positive infinity, or the rounding is half-even: -0.0312.
notes: No source shows a negative value converted to currency.
